title: Odd-A reflection asymmetry: bounded source data and conditional calculations
classification_note: Ba and Ra are alkaline-earth elements, Fr is alkali, Ce is lanthanide, and Ac/Th are actinides. Comparisons are by mass region.

theory.two_well_hamiltonian: H_I = [E_rot(I)+epsilon_q, -t_I; -t_I, E_rot(I)+epsilon_q] in mirror-localized states; parity projection gives E_±=E_rot+epsilon_q∓t_I if overlap is neglected.
theory.finite_overlap: For normalized mirror states with overlap s_I and Hamiltonian diagonal h_I, off-diagonal v_I: E_±=(h_I±v_I)/(1±s_I); these replace a universal 2t_I splitting.
theory.decoupling: For K=1/2, E_p(I)=E0_p+A_p[I(I+1)-1/4+a_p(-1)^(I+1/2)(I+1/2)]. Generalized a_p uses parity-projected Coriolis matrix elements and overlap normalization; the bare intrinsic expression alone is not an observable.
theory.splitting: At identical I and common A, ΔE(I)=2t_I+A(a_−−a_+)(-1)^(I+1/2)(I+1/2); with differing A or bandheads include their differences. If parity branches have different observed I, use an interpolated parity displacement instead.
theory.rotor_strengths: B(E1)=3D0²/(4π)|<I K 1 0|I−1 K>|²; B(E2)=5Q0²/(16π)|<I K 2 0|I−2 K>|²; ratio=(12/5)(D0/Q0)²(CG1²/CG2²), in fm^−2 for D0[e fm], Q0[e fm²].
theory.BCS_response: χ3(0)∝Σ_ij 2|Q3_ij|²(u_i v_j+v_i u_j)²/(E_i+E_j), with convention-dependent degeneracy factors; blocking must remove or modify specific magnetic-substate channels and recompute pairing/mean field.

inference_limits: B(E1)/B(E2) depends on D0 cancellation, Q0, K mixing, branching, conversion and lifetimes; no universal static-shape threshold.
Strong E3 in even Ba cannot determine the odd-neighbor ground-state parity structure.
No empirical actinide/lanthanide response ratio can be obtained without matched quasiparticle spectra, pairing and octupole matrix elements.
